title: PostgreSQL
simpleMetaphor: Ultra-reliable open-source relational database storing data in structured tables.
technicalExplanation: Powerful object-relational database system (RDBMS) with strong ACID compliance and JSON support.

title: MySQL
simpleMetaphor: Classic relational database powering millions of web applications worldwide.
technicalExplanation: Widely deployed relational database management system used across web ecosystems like WordPress.

title: MongoDB
simpleMetaphor: Stores data in flexible, JSON-like documents instead of rigid table schemas.
technicalExplanation: Document-oriented NoSQL database designed for high availability and horizontal scaling.

title: Redis
simpleMetaphor: Super-fast in-memory cache used for session storage, rate limiting, and temporary data.
technicalExplanation: In-memory data structure store used as a database, cache, streaming engine, and message broker.

title: Supabase
simpleMetaphor: Open-source Firebase alternative powered by PostgreSQL with instant APIs and Auth.
technicalExplanation: Backend-as-a-Service providing auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs, auth, and real-time listeners over Postgres.

title: Firebase
simpleMetaphor: Google's real-time cloud database and auth platform for quick MVP launches.
technicalExplanation: Cloud platform providing Firestore NoSQL database, authentication, hosting, and serverless functions.

title: Prisma ORM
simpleMetaphor: Typesafe translator to query databases in TypeScript without writing raw SQL strings.
technicalExplanation: Next-generation ORM featuring auto-generated type declarations and declarative schema migrations.

title: Drizzle ORM
simpleMetaphor: Lightweight TypeScript ORM that feels like writing clean SQL with autocomplete.
technicalExplanation: Headless TypeScript ORM with zero dependencies and maximum query performance.

title: Vector DBs (Pinecone)
simpleMetaphor: Specialized database that stores AI embeddings to search data by semantic meaning.
technicalExplanation: Vector index database optimized for high-dimensional similarity searches in RAG pipelines.
